description: Search for earthquakes near a geographic location using the Swiss Seismological Service (SED) FDSN API. Useful for finding seismic activity near a Swiss city, landmark, or custom coordinates.

days.description: Number of past days to search (default: 90, max: 365)

lat.description: Latitude of the center point (decimal degrees, e.g. 46.9 for Bern)

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 20, max: 100)

lon.description: Longitude of the center point (decimal degrees, e.g. 7.5 for Bern)

name: search_earthquakes_by_location
